basic_info.description: Welcome to 2322 25th Ave, San Francisco. This timeless treasure is making its debut on the market after more than 50 years. Located in the highly desired Parkside district, this 1925-built home is a blank canvas in one of the city's most sought-after neighborhoods. A welcoming entry separates the living room which includes a fireplace from the dining room via beautiful French doors with beveled glass panes. The kitchen offers a functional space and opens to a cozy breakfast room with a built-in hutch, a half bath & direct access to the large yard. Upstairs offers 3 bedrooms & a full bath that retains its vintage allure. Distant ocean views are enjoyed from 2 bedrooms. Additional features include a 1 car garage, ample storage, and a handy workbench.   Lovingly maintained by the same family, this home presents endless possibilities. It is conveniently located with excellent access to public transportation making commuting a breeze. With a high walkability score, residents can enjoy nearby parks, schools, shops, and dining options with ease. Embrace the vibrant community life that the Parkside district offers, enriched by its friendly atmosphere and abundant amenities.
